name: omniroute
description: Connects Claude Code to a locally running OmniRoute AI gateway (https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute) over its Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, exposing its provider, routing, combo, usage, and cost tools. Includes a skill that configures Claude Code to send its own model requests through the gateway. Requires OmniRoute to be installed and running locally with an API key.
